species.name: Mallard (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Iridescent bottle-green head, crisp white collar ring, bright yellow bill, curled black tail coverts
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Unspotted yellow bill, deep chestnut chest, silver-gray flanks
species.crux_caption: Wing in flight: Royal blue-violet speculum bordered by two clean white bars

diagnostics.mark: Iridescent bottle-green head separated from chest by a neat, crisp white neck ring.
Bright greenish-yellow to yellow bill, unspotted and contrasting with dark head.
Deep purplish-chestnut breast; white tail with diagnostic black upward-curled central feathers.

species.rule_out: Bottle-green head + crisp white neck ring + yellow bill + curled black tail coverts = Mallard Drake.

species.name: Mallard (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Mottled drab brown body, orange bill with dark culmen saddle, blue speculum with two white bars
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Orange bill with dark central saddle, transocular dark eyeline, mottled brown flanks
species.crux_caption: Flank & tail: Contrasting pale whitish tail, bold orange-and-black bill, mottled plumage

diagnostics.mark: Dull orange with a variable dark dusky saddle or splotches concentrated along the culmen ridge.
Bright iridescent blue-violet speculum bordered by two bold, stark white stripes (front and rear).
Contrasting pale whitish tail; dark eyeline cutting across buffy face from bill to nape.

species.rule_out: Dull orange bill with dark central saddle + two white bars flanking blue speculum + pale tail = Mallard Hen.

species.name: American Black Duck
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Deep sooty blackish-brown body, pale grayish-buff neck, unspotted olive bill, violet speculum
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Substantially darker than hen Mallard; pale head sharply contrasts with dark sooty body
species.crux_caption: Wing speculum: Rich violet-blue speculum with black borders and NO white leading edge bar

diagnostics.mark: Substantially darker than hen Mallard; overall deep sooty blackish-brown body without pale tail.
Pale grayish-buff, finely-streaked head and neck sharply contrasting with the dark body.
Violet-purple speculum bordered in black; lacks the bold white leading edge bar of Mallard.

species.rule_out: Sooty black-brown body + pale contrasting gray head + unspotted olive bill + no white in speculum = American Black Duck.

species.name: Gadwall (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Vermiculated gray body, sandy head with steep forehead, dark slate bill, jet-black stern, white speculum
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Intricately patterned gray flanks, plain brownish head, jet-black rear rump/undertail
species.crux_caption: Flank view: Square head shape, dark bill, and bright white speculum patch visible on lower flank

diagnostics.mark: Jet-black rump, uppertail, and undertail coverts forming a crisp black stern against gray flanks.
Diagnostic clean white rectangular speculum patch bordered by black and chestnut (often visible at rest).
Plain sandy grayish-brown head with steep forehead; relatively small, all-dark slate bill.

species.rule_out: Finely vermiculated gray body + jet-black stern + plain sandy head + white speculum patch = Gadwall Drake.

species.name: Gadwall (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Steep forehead, two-tone bill with orange sides and dark center, white rectangular speculum patch
species.photo_caption: Wing flap: Diagnostic clean white speculum square (crucial crux separating from Hen Mallard)
species.crux_caption: Field profile: Sleek build, steep forehead, orange-edged bill with neat dark culmen line

diagnostics.mark: Crucial crux: Brilliant white speculum patch (Hen Mallard has blue; Black Duck has dark violet).
Neat yellow-orange edges along the sides with a well-defined dark slate culmen stripe down center.
Noticeably smaller, sleeker, and steeper-foreheaded than Hen Mallard; plain grayish-buff face.

species.rule_out: Bright white speculum patch + orange bill sides with dark center ridge + steep forehead = Gadwall Hen.

species.name: Wood Duck (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Sweeping green-purple crest, ornate white bridle stripes, scarlet eye, burgundy chest, buff flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Extravagant crested head, scarlet eye and bill base, golden-buff vermiculated flanks
species.crux_caption: Head close-up: Ornate white facial bridles, crimson eye, white chin patch, patterned bill

diagnostics.mark: Sweeping iridescent green-and-purple crest with bold, crisp white accent lines extending back.
Bright fiery-red eye and matching red-and-white base to bill with black tip.
Rich burgundy-chestnut breast flecked with white triangles; delicate golden-buff flanks.

species.rule_out: Sweeping crested green head + white facial bridles + fiery red eye + chestnut breast = Wood Duck Drake.

species.name: Wood Duck (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Bold snow-white teardrop eye spectacle, bushy drooping crest, dark bill with pale basal line
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Sleek crested grayish-brown body, bold snow-white teardrop patch around eye
species.crux_caption: Swimming posture: Bushy crest, teardrop spectacle, iridescent bronze-blue wing flashes

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic bold, teardrop-shaped snow-white spectacle completely encircling eye and tapering rearward.
Muted grayish head with a distinct, slightly drooped bushy crest at rear of crown.
Warm brownish-gray chest neatly mottled with soft buffy-white teardrop spots.

species.rule_out: Bold white teardrop eye spectacle + swept-back crest + dark slender bill = Wood Duck Hen.

species.name: Green-winged Teal (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Chestnut head with iridescent green swoosh, vertical white breast bar, yellow buff undertail patch
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Tiny compact size, rich chestnut head with green eye swoosh, vertical white shoulder bar
species.crux_caption: Resting view: Creamy yellowish-buff triangle under tail, finely vermiculated gray body

diagnostics.mark: Rich cinnamon-chestnut head marked with a broad, curving iridescent emerald-green swoosh through eye.
Prominent, crisp vertical white crescent bar on the side of the breast in front of the wing.
Bright creamy yellowish-buff patch on undertail coverts; smallest North American dabbling duck.

species.rule_out: Tiny body + chestnut head with green eye swoosh + vertical white shoulder bar = Green-winged Teal Drake.

species.name: Green-winged Teal (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Petite dove-like build, mottled brown plumage, dark eyeline, small dark bill, green speculum flash
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Petite compact body, mottled brown plumage, dark eyeline, small neat blackish bill
species.crux_caption: Close profile: Diminutive size, steep forehead, bright iridescent green speculum flash

diagnostics.mark: Diminutive, compact, dove-like size (roughly half the bulk of a Mallard Hen).
Bright metallic green speculum bordered by buffy-white bars (often visible as a bright flash).
Dark horizontal eyeline across buff face; small, slender, all-dark slate-black bill.

species.rule_out: Very tiny size + petite dark bill + bright green speculum flash + mottled brown plumage = Green-winged Teal Hen.

species.name: Ring-necked Duck (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Peaked angular crown, solid black back, white vertical breast spur, two white bill rings, yellow eye
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Peaked angular head, jet-black back, white breast crescent, bold white bill ring near black tip
species.crux_caption: Swimming view: Pale gray flanks, peaked crown bump, bright yellow eye, white bill base and subterminal ring

diagnostics.mark: Two distinct white bands: a bold white ring near the black tip AND a white outline at the bill base.
Tall, angular peaked crown (highest point behind center of head); purplish-black sheen.
Jet-black back contrasting with pale gray flanks; prominent white vertical spur rising up front of flank.

species.rule_out: Peaked angular crown + jet-black back + white vertical flank spur + bold white bill ring = Ring-necked Drake.

species.name: Ring-necked Duck (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Peaked crown, white eye-ring with postocular line, subterminal white bill band, pale bill base
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Warm brown body, peaked crown, prominent white eye-ring with trailing streak
species.crux_caption: Head detail: Diffuse pale bill base, peaked rear crown, subterminal white bill band near black tip

diagnostics.mark: Crisp white eye-ring with a faint pale white line extending rearward toward the nape.
Subterminal white band across bill near the black tip; diffuse pale whitish area around base of bill.
Angular, peaked crown shape identical to drake; warm chocolate-brown body with paler flanks.

species.rule_out: Peaked crown + white eye-ring with trailing line + white bill band near black tip = Ring-necked Duck Hen.

species.name: Ruddy Duck (Winter Male)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Solid dark cap to eye level, stark pure white cheek, scooped dusky bill, cocked stiff spiky tail
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Winter basic plumage showing stark clean white cheek patch and cocked stiff spiky tail
species.crux_caption: Resting posture: Compact dumpy body, scooped dark bill, diagnostic pure white cheek

diagnostics.mark: Stark, completely clean, uninterrupted snow-white cheek patch (from bill to nape, below eye).
Solid dark blackish cap extending straight across head at eye level; large scooped dusky-gray bill.
Diagnostic stiff, pointed, spiky tail feathers, frequently held cocked vertically upright.

species.rule_out: Solid dark cap + pure white cheek + cocked stiff spiky tail + scooped bill = Ruddy Duck (Winter Male).

species.name: Ruddy Duck (Hen / Imm)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Dark cap, pale cheek bisected by horizontal dark cheek stripe, scooped bill, stiff upright tail
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dark cap, dirty whitish cheek bisected by a prominent dark horizontal cheek stripe, stiff tail
species.crux_caption: Swimming profile: Compact body, scooped bill, horizontal dark stripe cutting across pale cheek

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic dark dusky horizontal stripe cutting right through the middle of the pale cheek.
Dark brownish-gray cap with less sharp contrast than winter male; mottled grayish body.
Stiff spiky tail often cocked straight up; low, buoyant swimming profile with thick neck.

species.rule_out: Dark cap + horizontal dark stripe bisecting pale cheek + cocked stiff spiky tail = Ruddy Duck (Hen / Immature).

species.name: Bufflehead (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Puffy bulbous head, giant snow-white pie-wedge patch from eye across nape, black back, white flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Puffy head with giant brilliant white pie-wedge patch, gleaming white body, black back
species.crux_caption: Active swimming view: Tiny compact diver, iridescent green/purple sheen on front of puffy head

diagnostics.mark: Giant, unmistakable snow-white wedge wrapping from behind the eye completely across the nape.
Puffy, bulbous head with rich iridescent violet, green, and bronze sheen on black face.
Very small, buoyant diving duck; gleaming pure white flanks and belly contrasting with black back.

species.rule_out: Enormous white wedge on puffy dark head + gleaming white body + tiny compact diving build = Bufflehead Drake.

species.name: Bufflehead (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Tiny dark diver, rounded puffy head with neat single horizontal oval white cheek patch, stubby bill
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Diminutive dark gray-brown diver, neat clean white oval cheek patch behind eye
species.crux_caption: Swimming posture: Petite size, round puffy head, distinct single white cheek slash

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic single, neat, horizontal oval white patch or slash centered directly behind the eye.
Dark brownish-gray upperparts and paler gray breast/flanks; small, stubby slate bill.
One of the smallest North American diving ducks; continually pops to surface like a buoyant cork.

species.rule_out: Tiny dark diver + neat single oval white cheek patch behind eye + stubby bill = Bufflehead Hen.

species.name: Hooded Merganser (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive circular white fan-crest outlined in black, thin serrated bill, yellow eye, cinnamon flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Enormous fan-shaped crest with giant white patch, thin serrated bill, rich tawny flanks
species.crux_caption: Swimming profile: Vertical black-and-white breast spurs, yellow eye, ornate collapsible crest

diagnostics.mark: Massive circular fan-shaped crest dominated by a huge white patch crisply framed in black.
Slender, narrow, black saw-toothed (serrated) bill specialized for grasping small fish.
Warm reddish-tawny / cinnamon flanks; two black breast spurs; piercing yellow eye.

species.rule_out: Massive white fan crest outlined in black + narrow serrated bill + tawny flanks = Hooded Merganser Drake.

species.name: Hooded Merganser (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Bushy ragged cinnamon-rufous crest, slender serrated bill with orange edge, dark brown eye
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Shaggy bushy cinnamon-rufous crest, slender dark serrated bill with orange base, dark body
species.crux_caption: Swimming view: Bushy cinnamon crest, slender serrated bill, dark brown eye and flanks

diagnostics.mark: Distinctive bushy, ragged, punk-rock cinnamon-rufous / golden crest projecting from rear of head.
Slender, narrow, serrated bill with dark upper culmen and dull yellow-orange lower mandible.
Overall dark sooty grayish-brown body with white wing bar; dark brown eye (unlike drake's yellow).

species.rule_out: Ragged bushy cinnamon crest + slender serrated bill with orange edge + dark brown eye = Hooded Merganser Hen.

species.name: Northern Pintail (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Chocolate-brown head, snow-white neck stripe, very long slender neck, needle-point tail
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Chocolate-brown head, snow-white breast extending up neck in crisp finger stripe, needle tail
species.crux_caption: Swimming posture: Slender graceful neck, vermiculated gray sides, extremely long pointed tail

diagnostics.mark: Snow-white breast extends up the sides of the neck in a thin, elegant, clean white finger stripe.
Warm chocolate-brown head; two-tone bill (blue-gray sides with black central stripe).
Extremely long, graceful, slender neck and exceptionally elongated needle-point central tail feathers.

species.rule_out: Chocolate head + clean white neck stripe + long slender neck + needle-point tail = Northern Pintail Drake.

species.name: Northern Pintail (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Long slender graceful neck, plain unmarked tan head, solid dark slate bill, pointed central tail
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Slender graceful neck, plain unmarked tan head, dark slate-gray bill (not orange!)
species.crux_caption: Swimming view: Elegant long neck, warm buffy throat, all-dark slate bill, pointed central tail

diagnostics.mark: Noticeably long, slender, graceful swan-like neck held upright while swimming.
All-dark slate-gray / blackish bill (completely lacks the orange/yellow tones of Hen Mallard & Gadwall).
Plain, warm buffy-tan head without bold dark eyeline; pointed central tail feathers.

species.rule_out: Long slender neck + plain unmarked tan head + solid dark slate bill + pointed tail = Northern Pintail Hen.

species.name: Northern Shoveler (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive black spoon bill, iridescent bottle-green head, white chest, rich chestnut flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Massive spatulate black spoon bill, green head, white chest, rich chestnut flanks
species.crux_caption: Resting view: Giant spatulate bill, bright yellow eye, white breast, chestnut belly

diagnostics.mark: Massive, disproportionately large spatulate (spoon-shaped) black bill, wider at the tip than at the base.
High-contrast tri-color: iridescent green head, snow-white breast, and rich rufous/chestnut sides.
Bright, piercing lemon-yellow eye set against the dark green head.

species.rule_out: Massive black spoon-shaped bill + green head + white breast + chestnut sides = Northern Shoveler Drake.

species.name: Northern Shoveler (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Enormous spoon-shaped bill with orange sides and fine straining lamellae, front-heavy build
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Massive spatulate orange-and-brown spoon bill, mottled brown body, orange legs (100% diagnostic)
species.crux_caption: Bill close-up: Giant spoon bill with comb-like filtering lamellae, warm buffy-brown plumage

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic massive spoon-shaped bill with dull orange sides and fine comb-like straining lamellae visible.
Swims low in front, appearing front-heavy and slouched due to the enormous weight of the bill.
Coarsely mottled grayish-brown plumage with bright orange legs and feet.

species.rule_out: Massive spoon-shaped bill (larger than head) + dull orange bill edges + mottled brown body = Northern Shoveler Hen.

species.name: American Wigeon (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: White forehead ('baldpate'), iridescent green eye patch, small lead-blue bill, pinkish flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Bright white forehead ('baldpate'), broad green eye patch, small pale blue bill with black tip
species.crux_caption: Swimming view: Small blue bill with black tip, speckled gray neck, clean white flank patch

diagnostics.mark: Bright shining white to creamy forehead and crown ('baldpate') bordered by a broad iridescent green patch.
Small, stubby, pale grayish-blue bill with a clean, well-defined black tip.
Warm pinkish-cinnamon flanks contrasting with clean white belly patch and black undertail coverts.

species.rule_out: White forehead stripe + green eye patch + small pale blue bill with black tip = American Wigeon Drake.

species.name: American Wigeon (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Round head, dark eye smudge, small lead-blue black-tipped bill, warm cinnamon flanks
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Round head, small pale blue bill with black tip, warm reddish-cinnamon flanks
species.crux_caption: Resting view: Dark smudge around eye, steep forehead, small blue bill, clean white belly

diagnostics.mark: Small, stubby, pale lead-blue bill with a sharp black tip (identical to drake; separates from Mallard/Gadwall).
Finely speckled grayish head and neck contrasting sharply with warm reddish-cinnamon flanks.
Distinct dark dusky smudge or 'mascara' around the dark eye on a rounded head with steep forehead.

species.rule_out: Small pale blue bill with black tip + gray head contrasting with warm cinnamon flanks = American Wigeon Hen.

species.name: Lesser Scaup (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Peaked rear crown bump, purplish head sheen, blue bill with small nail, vermiculated gray back
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Purplish-black head with peaked rear crown bump, finely barred white/gray back, blue bill
species.crux_caption: Swimming profile: Pale blue bill ('bluebill'), steep rear head peak, bright white flanks

diagnostics.mark: Distinct angular crown with a peaked bump or corner at the rear of the head (Greater Scaup is smoothly rounded).
Pale bluish-gray bill ('bluebill') with a small, narrow black nail at the tip.
Purplish gloss on black head (in good sun); pale grayish-white back with fine dark vermiculations.

species.rule_out: Peaked rear crown bump + pale blue bill with small nail + vermiculated whitish back = Lesser Scaup Drake.

species.name: Lesser Scaup (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Stark white patch encircling bill base, peaked rear crown bump, lead-blue bill, yellow eye
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dark brown diver, peaked rear crown, diagnostic stark white patch encircling base of bill
species.crux_caption: Profile view: Crisp white face patch against pale blue bill, peaked crown, yellow eye

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic crisp, stark snow-white patch completely encircling the base of the bill.
Noticeable peak or angular bump at the rear of the crown (unlike smoothly rounded Greater Scaup).
Pale bluish-gray bill with narrow dark nail; bright lemon-yellow eye set in dark brown face.

species.rule_out: Stark white patch around bill base + peaked rear crown + pale blue bill + yellow eye = Lesser Scaup Hen.

species.name: Tufted Duck (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Long drooping nape tuft, solid black back, gleaming stark white flanks, blue bill with black tip
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Eurasian vagrant in MD; prominent drooping head tuft, stark white sides, yellow eye
species.crux_caption: Flock comparison: Black back like Ring-necked Duck, but clean white flanks like Scaup; no white bill ring

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic long, slender, drooping black tuft hanging off the rear of the crown down the nape.
Solid jet-black back (like Ring-necked) combined with gleaming pure snow-white flanks (like Scaup).
Pale bluish-gray bill with a broad black tip and small pale line behind nail; bright golden-yellow eye.

species.rule_out: Long drooping nape crest + solid black back + gleaming white flanks + plain blue bill (no white ring) = Tufted Duck Drake [RARE].

species.name: Tufted Duck (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Chocolate-brown diving duck, distinct rear crown tuft/bump, variable white at bill base
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dark brown diver with distinct short tuft at rear crown, pale flank wash, yellow eye
species.crux_caption: Resting view: Narrow pale feathers around bill base (can mimic Scaup, but note rear crown tuft and dark back)

diagnostics.mark: Short but distinct pointed tuft or swept-back crest bump at the rear of the crown.
Variable, narrow white feathering encircling the base of the bill (less extensive/stark than Scaup Hen).
Overall dark sooty-brown plumage; darker back than Lesser Scaup; bright yellow eye.

species.rule_out: Dark brown diving duck + short rear crown tuft + narrow pale bill base + yellow eye = Tufted Duck Hen [RARE].

species.name: Eurasian Wigeon (Drake)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Rich cinnamon-rufous head, contrasting buff-yellow cream forehead, vermiculated silver-gray body
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Regular Eurasian rarity in MD; bright buff-cream crown stripe, rich reddish head, gray flanks
species.crux_caption: Comparison crux: Lacks the white baldpate and green mask of American Wigeon; flanks are silver-gray, not pink-brown

diagnostics.mark: Rich cinnamon-chestnut / rufous head with a contrasting bright buff-yellow cream forehead stripe.
Finely vermiculated silver-gray flanks (completely lacks American Wigeon's warm pinkish-cinnamon wash).
Dusky grayish axillaries (underwing armpit feathers), contrasting with pure white axillaries of American Wigeon.

species.rule_out: Rich chestnut-red head + buff/yellow cream forehead + silver-gray flanks = Eurasian Wigeon Drake [RARE].

species.name: Eurasian Wigeon (Hen)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Warm rufous wash across head and breast, low contrast with flanks, lead-blue bill, white belly
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Overall warmer, more uniform reddish-brown tone than American Wigeon hen
species.crux_caption: Crux check: Grayish axillaries (underwing); head and flanks blend without the frosty gray vs cinnamon clash

diagnostics.mark: Warm reddish-buff / rufous wash across entire head and neck, blending smoothly into the rufous flanks.
Lacks the distinct clash between frosty gray head and warm cinnamon flanks of American Wigeon hen.
Dusky grayish axillaries / underwing coverts (American Wigeon has clean pure white axillaries).

species.rule_out: Uniform warm reddish wash across head and flanks (no frosty gray head contrast) + gray underwing = Eurasian Wigeon Hen [RARE].
